title: Resolution urging Albany to allow a New York City public bank
summary: This resolution calls on the state legislature to pass, and the governor to sign, A.11513, the “Bank of New York City Act.” The bill would let cities with populations over one million establish a municipal public bank governed by a nine-member board and a fifteen-member advisory board, focused on lending to affordable housing, worker cooperatives, renewable energy and underserved communities. The bank would not accept public deposits or engage in retail banking and would be subject to annual audits.
